title: Meteor's PvP Pack
description: My optimal collection of Pvp and general use mods.
body:
## Overview

A lightweight Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.11 designed around smoother performance and quality-of-life improvements for multiplayer servers.

## Performance Improvements

This modpack includes several optimization mods intended to keep gameplay responsive during fights and in areas with many players.

* **VulkanMod** replaces Minecraft's default rendering backend with Vulkan to improve rendering performance on supported systems.
* **Very Many Players** improves multiplayer performance, especially on servers with a large number of players.
* **View Distance Fix** helps the client correctly handle server view-distance settings.
* **Remove Reloading Screen** reduces interruptions caused by resource reload screens.

These improvements make the pack useful for players who want a smoother experience during PvP, while exploring SMP servers, or when playing in busy multiplayer areas.

## PvP Features

The pack includes several tools that make combat information easier to access without adding unnecessary clutter.

* **Shield Fixes** improves shield behavior and helps make shield-based combat feel more consistent.
* **Simple Armor HUD** displays armor durability on screen so you can quickly tell when your gear is close to breaking.
* **Tier Tagger** displays PvP tier information for supported players.
* **Zume** adds a convenient zoom feature for checking distant players and surroundings.

## Multiplayer and Quality-of-Life Features

Several smaller additions improve normal gameplay outside of fights as well.

* **Simple Voice Chat** adds proximity voice chat for supported multiplayer servers.
* **Shulker Box Tooltip** lets you preview the contents of shulker boxes without placing them.
* **Not Enough Animations** adds additional third-person animations.
* **No Resource Pack Warnings** removes repetitive resource-pack warning screens.
* **Searchables** improves searching in supported menus.
* **ViaFabricPlus** provides compatibility options for connecting to servers on different supported Minecraft versions.

## Who Is This Pack For?

This pack is made for players who want a lightweight client-side setup for:

* SMP servers
* Sword PvP
* Crystal PvP
* Multiplayer survival
* Busy PvP practice servers
* Players who want improved performance without excessive visual changes

It is a practical option for anyone looking for smoother gameplay, clearer combat information, and useful multiplayer features while keeping the overall Minecraft experience close to vanilla.
